Extract right-to-left text direction

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<html lang=\"ar\" dir=\"rtl\"><head><title>RTL Document</title></head><body><p>This is right-to-left text.</p></body></html>", "{\"extract_metadata\":true}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
